ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic Bode plot, with the horizontal axis labeled log(ω). The magnitude-frequency curve is a horizontal straight line, indicating that the magnitude remains constant with frequency; the phase-frequency curve starts near 0° at low frequency, decreases as frequency increases, and asymptotically approaches -180° at high frequency. Reasoning: The system is stable, so the poles of the system must be in the left half-plane. The magnitude curve remains flat, indicating that the -20 dB/dec slope brought by a first-order pole must be canceled by the +20 dB/dec slope brought by a zero, so the pole and zero should be at the same corner frequency. A left-half-plane pole contributes -90° phase at high frequency. The total high-frequency phase is -180°, so the zero still needs to contribute another -90°. A left-half-plane zero contributes +90°, while a right-half-plane zero contributes -90°, so this zero should be a right-half-plane zero. Thus the system has one LHP pole and one RHP zero at the same frequency.

method.method_draft: Describe the image: the magnitude asymptote is flat, while the phase drops from 0° to -180°. Since the system is stable, any pole must be in the LHP. A flat magnitude for a first-order pole-zero system means there must be one pole and one zero at the same corner frequency so their ±20 dB/dec slopes cancel. The LHP pole contributes -90° at high frequency. To reach a total high-frequency phase of -180°, the zero must also contribute -90°, which identifies it as a RHP zero. Therefore the system has one LHP pole and one RHP zero at the same frequency.

method.method_draft: Describe the image: the magnitude trace is horizontal and the phase trace tends to -180°, matching a first-order all-pass response. Model such a response as G(s)=K(a-s)/(a+s). Verify that the numerator and denominator have equal magnitudes on jω, explaining the flat magnitude in the plot, and that the phase tends to -180°, matching the plotted high-frequency phase. The pole is at s=-a, which is stable/LHP, and the zero is at s=+a, which is in the RHP. Since both use the same a, they occur at the same frequency.

推理：幅值对所有频率保持常数，同时相位从 0° 最终趋于 -180°，这符合一阶全通系统的特征。可用 G(s)=K(a-s)/(a+s) 表示，其中 a>0。代入 s=jω 时，分子和分母的模分别为 |a-jω| 和 |a+jω|，二者相等，因此幅值 |G(jω)|=|K| 为常数。相位为 arg(a-jω)-arg(a+jω)=-tan⁻¹(ω/a)-tan⁻¹(ω/a)，当 ω→∞ 时趋于 -90°-90°=-180°。该系统的极点在 s=-a，位于左半平面，满足稳定性；零点在 s=+a，位于右半平面。由于二者都由同一个 a 决定，所以极点和零点对应相同的频率。
